title: Samsung RS28 — Self-diagnostic entry
description: Run self-diagnostic checklist (touchscreen §4-2-2 or LED keys §4-2-9).

steps.title: Touchscreen self-diagnosis
steps.body: Engineer mode → Fridge Function Test → Self Diagnosis. Errors list for 60 s (§4-2-2).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Engineer mode → Fridge Function Test → Self Diagnosis. Errors list for 60 s (§4-2-2).

steps.title: LED panel self-diagnosis
steps.body: Fridge + Power Cool 6 s (display blinks 4 s) then hold 10 s total — ding-dong, fault LEDs blink 30 s (§4-2-9). Cancel: Fridge + Power Cool 10 s.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Fridge + Power Cool 6 s (display blinks 4 s) then hold 10 s total — ding-dong, fault LEDs blink 30 s (§4-2-9). Cancel: Fridge + Power Cool 10 s.
